content.text: Great! I can see that "INFIRMIER" (code 24) is the French term for nurse. Now let me query the reimbursements table for February 2025 (FLX_ANN_MOI = 202502) where PSE_ACT_SNDS = 24:

input.sql:
SELECT SUM(PRS_ACT_NBR) as total_acts
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS
WHERE FLX_ANN_MOI = 202502 
AND PSE_ACT_SNDS = 24

content.text: Perfect! I found the answer. The nurses (INFIRMIER) performed 3,356,371 acts in claims processed in February 2025.
